description: 直接查询 SLS model-access。仅展示请求元数据与质量指标，不展示 prompt/response 内容。

panels.description: 按时间倒序显示最近请求。厂商筛选值是 upstream_cluster 搜索表达式，默认 *。只列有模型字段的请求；失败到没有模型字段的尝试看“请求尝试明细”。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, response_flags, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, CASE WHEN "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" THEN round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.input_token" AS input_tokens, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens, "ai_log.cached_tokens" AS cached_tokens, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, "ai_log.chat_id" AS chat_id, "ai_log.usage_status" AS usage_status WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 最近请求明细

panels.description: 按单请求 TTFT 从高到低排序，用于定位首 token 长尾。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: TTFT 最慢请求 Top 100

panels.description: TPOT=(完整服务时长-TTFT)/(输出 token-1)，输出 token 少于 2 时不计算。

targets.query: "ai_log.model": ${model} AND upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens WHERE "ai_log.model" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_log.model" <> '' AND "ai_log.model" <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" ORDER BY tpot_ms DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: TPOT 最慢请求 Top 100

panels.description: 网关最终返回 5xx 的请求，按时间倒序。不受“模型”变量过滤：失败的尝试往往没有 ai_log.model，按模型过滤会把它们全部滤掉。

targets.query: upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, response_flags, "ai_log.response_error" AS response_error WHERE coalesce("ai_log.model", '') <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND response_code >= 500 ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 5xx 请求明细

panels.description: 所有厂商 429 请求证据，用于观察授信、余额、并发保护或厂商侧限流。不受“模型”变量过滤——修复前该过滤会让本面板只能看到 1/42 条 429。

targets.query: upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, consumer AS tenant, "ai_log.model" AS model, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, "ai_log.rate_limit_evaluation" AS rate_limit_evaluation WHERE coalesce("ai_log.model", '') <> 'dashboard-mock' AND regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND response_code = 429 ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 429 请求证据明细

panels.description: 按请求 ID 展开每一次上游尝试：同一 request_id 出现多行即发生了重试/二次调度，按时间顺序就是尝试链。不做“模型”过滤，因为失败的尝试往往没有 ai_log.model。定位单次请求就把 request_id 填进上方的“请求 ID”。

targets.query: upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} AND request_id: ${request_id} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, consumer AS tenant, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, response_code, response_flags, "ai_log.model" AS model, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, "ai_log.chat_id" AS chat_id, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, CASE WHEN "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" THEN round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.input_token" AS input_tokens, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens, "ai_log.usage_status" AS usage_status, "ai_log.response_error" AS response_error WHERE regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') AND coalesce("ai_log.model", '') <> 'dashboard-mock' ORDER BY request_id, __time__ ASC LIMIT 300

panels.title: 请求尝试明细（含失败与二次调度）

panels.description: 只列被调度过一次以上的请求：attempts 是尝试次数，status_chain/provider_chain/time_chain 按发生顺序展开，hit_429=1 表示其中出现过 429，succeeded=1 表示最终有 2xx。看每次打到哪个上游、厂商返回的 id，用上方的“请求 ID”看“请求尝试明细”。

targets.query: upstream_cluster: ${provider} AND consumer: ${tenant} | SELECT request_id, count(*) AS attempts, array_join(array_agg(CAST(response_code AS varchar)), ' -> ') AS status_chain, array_join(array_agg(regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1)), ' -> ') AS provider_chain, array_join(array_agg(date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%H:%i:%s')), ' -> ') AS time_chain, max(CASE WHEN response_code = 429 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_429, max(CASE WHEN response_code >= 200 AND response_code < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeeded, sum(CASE WHEN "ai_log.output_token" > 0 THEN "ai_log.output_token" ELSE 0 END) AS output_tokens WHERE regexp_like(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-[^.]+[.]dns') GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY max(__time__) DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: 多次调度汇总（尝试链）

panels.description: 用厂商返回的请求 ID 反查我们的 request_id：把厂商给的 id 填进上方的“厂商请求 ID”。默认 * 列出所有带厂商 ID 的请求；厂商没回这个头的行不会出现在这里（那些行在“请求尝试明细”里仍可见）。

targets.query: "ai_log.upstream_request_id": ${upstream_request_id} AND consumer: ${tenant} | SELECT date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS time, request_id, "ai_log.upstream_request_id" AS upstream_request_id, "ai_log.chat_id" AS chat_id, consumer AS tenant, regexp_extract(upstream_cluster, 'tokenvolt-([^.]+)', 1) AS provider, "ai_log.model" AS model, response_code, "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" AS ttft_ms, CASE WHEN "ai_log.output_token" > 1 AND "ai_log.llm_service_duration" >= "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration" THEN round(("ai_log.llm_service_duration" - "ai_log.llm_first_token_duration") / ("ai_log.output_token" - 1), 2) ELSE NULL END AS tpot_ms, "ai_log.output_token" AS output_tokens, "ai_log.usage_status" AS usage_status WHERE "ai_log.upstream_request_id" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY __time__ DESC LIMIT 100
